dialogue.speaker: User
dialogue.content: Two heterogeneous robots (a legged Spot and a wheeled Fetch) operate in one shared multi-floor scene. Complete the benchmark objective: ensure that a robot reaches the object any_targets|0, and ensure that a robot reaches the goal receptacle position TARGET_any_targets|0. Decide yourselves how to divide the work between the available robots and carry it out.

assessment.objective: Ensure that at least one available robot reaches the object any_targets|0 and that at least one available robot reaches the goal receptacle position TARGET_any_targets|0.
constraints: Operate within the shared multi-floor scene using the available legged Spot and wheeled Fetch robots.
The requested destinations are the object identified as any_targets|0 and the goal receptacle position identified as TARGET_any_targets|0.
assumptions: The two reach conditions may be fulfilled by the same robot or by different robots; robot assignment and ordering are left open as requested.
Reaching the object and the receptacle position does not imply grasping, transporting, placing, or handoff.
